0.3.1 staged initiative

Capability first. Claims after validation.

The marketplace and package ecosystem ships internally behind flags. No public launch occurs until identity, legal, restore, security, and native platform gates are complete.

Implemented foundation

Data + package contracts

RLS-first schema, bounded APIs, deterministic asset archives, project manifests, lockfiles, cache mounts, embedding, and recovery.

Active

Hub and Editor surfaces

Marketplace browsing, browser sign-in adapter, local broker, Package Manager UI, selective imports, and multi-root assets.

Validation

Security and operations

Validator isolation, signature ceremony, restore rehearsal, abuse controls, accessibility, performance, and cross-platform matrices.

Public gate

Branded production launch

Custom domain, SMTP, legal approval, finalized OAuth callbacks, monitoring, and native Windows/Linux completion.
